card.capacity_status_quote: So look, I think the thing that surprised us was the slope and duration of how quickly the business started to ramp into the first half. card.demand_direction_quote: For 2026, we expect sequential revenue growth for the company to accelerate, leading to high teen revenue growth year-over-year in the semiconductor process control systems business to grow over 20%.
card.pricing_power_quote: Yes, Shane, we don't price based on scarcity at KLA, our pricing is based on cost of ownership improvements from one generation to the next.
